card.title: You Owe Me the Chance
card.instruction: Treat a past sacrifice, concession, or missed opportunity as a debt that should now be repaid with a real advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You had the good room on our last holiday. I'm choosing this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you liked the sofa bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was generous in both room allocation and commentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The balcony room costs extra. I can pay the difference.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. You cover the upgrade and I'll take the balcony. Last year's sofa bed can cover my share.

mechanism: A accounts for an earlier sofa bed as a debt that entitles them to a paid balcony upgrade.
confusable: Unlike preferring luxury, A must use a past concession as current purchasing power.
comparison: S200-b monetizes a lodging sacrifice; S200-a claims first repertoire choice from a missed audition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
